card.name: Just before an exclamation mark
card.fires_on: The word or word piece right before an expected '!' in the text, such as the 'Alert' in EurekAlert! or 'Error' in 'Error! Hyperlink'. It also fires on odd pieces of broken or foreign words and on spaced-out capital letters.

modes.label: Names with built-in !
modes.description: Brand or error text where an exclamation mark follows the marked word.

modes.label: Interjections in odd text
modes.description: Pieces of foreign-language words next to exclamations like 'Alas!' or 'Ohokio!'.

modes.label: Phrases ending a sentence
modes.description: Words at the end of a sharing or call-to-action line, where punctuation could follow.

card.writes: It promotes exclamation marks as the next output and suppresses unrelated odd tokens.
card.plain: It fires on a word that is likely to be followed directly by an exclamation mark.
